info.title: Pointwise API
info.description: Credit-card rewards optimization API. All money values are integer cents.

lastFour.description: last 4 digits (5 for Amex) — never a full card number

openDatePrecision.description: MONTH when only the month is known (credit reports)

trackBenefits.description: copy the card product's catalog benefits

excludeFrom524.description: manually exclude from 5/24 (e.g. AU card removed on reconsideration)

snoozedUntil.description: ISO date to snooze until; null to unsnooze

candidateCardId.description: catalog card to compare against the current wallet (Pro)

kind.description: CREDIT = a statement credit from the issuer

creditBand.description: Self-reported credit score band (optional; used only by the next-card scorer, never sent to an AI provider)

goals.description: Reward goals used by the recommendation engine (never sent to an AI provider)

creditBand.description: Self-reported credit score band (optional; used only by the next-card scorer, never sent to an AI provider)

goals.description: Reward goals used by the recommendation engine (never sent to an AI provider)

usedOn.description: defaults to now; decides which period the usage counts toward

overwrite.description: LINK: replace an open date already on the card

bureaus.description: bureaus whose reports listed the account

openedOn.description: credit reports show month granularity; the 1st of the month is fine

walletCardId.description: link to a wallet card explicitly (otherwise auto-matched)

consent.description: Consent to send your card data to the selected AI provider

classifyMerchants.description: Let the selected model classify cleaned merchant names (no amounts, dates, card digits or names) to detect benefit credits

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable holding the key, e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY
Environment variable holding the key, e.g. OPENAI_API_KEY

question.description: The question being answered (kept in the run log)

narrate.description: Let a permitted model rewrite the answer. Your own data is only ever shown to a local model.

url.description: https URL on an allow-listed issuer domain

text.description: Text (or HTML) copied from the public product page

value.description: Approve with an edited value instead of the proposed one

code.description: Reward currency code (e.g. NW_MILES) or loyalty program code (e.g. SKYHIGH)

kind.description: DISCOVER an issuer's cards, VERIFY one catalog card, or scan card NEWS sites for new cards and offers

issuer.description: DISCOVER: issuer to research (NEWS: optional issuer filter)

useLeads.description: Let the agent read card news / community sites (Doctor of Credit, The Points Guy, MileMoa) for leads. Facts still come only from issuer pages.

staleDays.description: skip issuers researched within this many days

acceptUnverified.description: Approve although no fact could be checked against the product page

applyRewards.description: Existing card: replace its earning rates with the verified rates

centsPerPoint.description: New points currency: default ¢ per point (0–5)

password.description: An app password (not your main password). Stored encrypted; never returned.

remember.description: Save the alert's last digits on the card so later alerts are matched automatically
